scoring_justification: Full recompute of DFT+phonon results is infeasible in the verifier sandbox; we check structural properties (presence and location of soft modes, space group, sign of frequencies) and compare key displacement magnitudes to the paper's reported values with tolerance.

hidden_assets.generation_method: extracted from paper description: 'Ta 0.025 Å, Re 0.101 Å, Si 0.046 Å for Γ-mode; Ta 0.061 Å, Re 0.153 Å, Si 0.098 Å for S-mode'
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the exact paper-reported values to be matched within tolerance; they are consistent with the reference solution.

hidden_assets.purpose: qpoint locations and expected negative frequency sign for ima2 instability
hidden_assets.source_provenance: paper text: soft modes at Γ (0,0,0) and S (0.5,0,0)
hidden_assets.generation_method: extracted from paper; arbitrary negative values used by reference solve.sh (-5.2, -7.8) are not checked, only sign and qpoint presence
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: The checker only verifies structural presence and sign, not exact magnitudes, so the inline values are descriptive.

outputs.description: Dynamical stability analysis of the Ima2 structure: reports imaginary phonon modes at Γ and S points if the structure is unstable.
Atomic displacement magnitudes (in Å) at the energy-minimizing distortions along the Γ- and S-point soft-mode eigenvectors.
Relaxed crystal structure obtained from the S-mode soft-mode distortion; expected space group Cm (No. 8).
Phonon stability verification for the relaxed Cm structure: confirms no imaginary phonon modes.

output_contract.notes: All artifacts must be produced by the ordered workflow. The energy scan and phonon calculations are computationally heavy; the agent may use external high-performance computing resources. The displacement magnitudes are scored against the paper reference with tolerance; the other artefacts are checked for correct structural or boolean properties.

steps.description: Verify presence of imaginary modes at Γ and S, and negative minimum frequency.
Check displacement magnitudes against paper-reported values within ±0.02 Å.
Parse CIF and confirm space group is Cm (No. 8).
Verify no imaginary modes in Cm structure (all positive, min frequency >= -1 cm⁻¹).
